name: L5 - four balls: two cut shots + two backstop kicks (no rail bounce required)
note: Four balls: 2 backstop balls kicked by the rewind (rule A) and 2 balls cut into pockets by the strike on the FIRST path segment (rule B). A ball placed past the first rail bounce was tried for this strike angle and rejected by the verified designer because the cue no longer had the energy to carry it into a pocket. This level is therefore NOT harder than L4 in mechanism - it exercises a different strike direction (345 deg) and a 60 deg cut. Honest label, see REPORT.md.
